info.title: HCMS API
info.description: Interactive API documentation for the Healthcare Conflict Management System (HCMS).

ManagedUser.description: User account as seen by an Administrator. Never includes the password hash.

account_status.description: INACTIVE means a Doctor or NGO applicant awaiting or rejected by Join Request review. SUSPENDED means deactivated by an Administrator.

assigned_requests.description: Assistance Requests ever assigned to this NGO

open_requests.description: Assigned requests in PENDING, UNDER_REVIEW, or APPROVED

national_id.description: Palestinian national ID. Must contain exactly 9 digits and must not start with 0.

specialization.description: One of the fixed specialization list. Accounts created before the list may hold an older free-text value.

appointment_date.description: Palestinian local wall-clock time in Asia/Hebron, serialized exactly as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in requests and responses. This value is not a UTC instant and has no timezone suffix.

AssignedPatient.description: Safe Patient profile returned to an assigned Doctor. National ID is not included.

title.description: English title. Clients that show other languages should build the text from event and event_status.

event.description: What happened. Null only for rows the back-fill could not match.

event_status.description: The new status for the two STATUS_CHANGED events, otherwise null.

user_id.description: Null only for LOGIN_FAILED with an email that has no account.

description.example: Display name of the HCMS platform

notes.description: Optional notes. Maximum size is 65535 UTF-8 bytes.
notes.example: Follow up with the patient regularly.

patient_name.description: Patient full name. Returned by the list and detail endpoints only.

doctor_name.description: Doctor full name. Returned by the list and detail endpoints only.

specialization.description: Doctor specialization. Returned by the list and detail endpoints only.

description.description: Emergency description. Maximum size is 65535 UTF-8 bytes.

DoctorEmergencyAlert.description: Emergency Alert as seen by its assigned Doctor. patient_name and patient_phone come from the registered Patient account and are null for Visitor alerts.

description.description: Assistance request description. Maximum size is 65535 UTF-8 bytes.
description.example: Patient requires medical supplies for continued treatment.

notes.description: Optional notes. Maximum size is 65535 UTF-8 bytes.

rejection_reason.example: Registration information could not be verified.

password.description: Must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit. Maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.

password_confirmation.description: Must exactly match password. Used for validation only and is never stored.

phone.description: Optional Palestinian mobile number. Must be exactly 10 digits and start with 059 or 056.

example.email: email must be a valid email address

symptom_onset.description: Unknown onset is allowed; maximum 255 characters

LimitQuery.name: limit
LimitQuery.description: Items per page (at most 100). The default depends on the endpoint.

AuthenticationRequired.description: Authentication is required or the supplied token is invalid

AccountNotActive.description: The authenticated account is not active

patch.description: Changes the signed-in user's password after checking the current one. Any active role may call it. The new password follows the registration policy (at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes) and must differ from the current one. A wrong current password returns 400 with a field error, not 401. Only failed attempts count toward the rate limit (5 per 15 minutes by default). Recorded in the activity log as CHANGE_PASSWORD. Tokens issued before the change stay valid until they expire.
